glosses: to noodle (play a musical instrument or to sing in an improvisatory or lighthearted manner) around

examples.text: Oder auf einem Keyboard oder Klavier herumnudeln, bis etwas kommt, bei dem Ihre Ohren sich aufstellen wie bei einem Hund.
examples.translation: Or noodling around on a keyboard or piano until something comes along that makes your ears perk up like a dog's.
examples.english: Or noodling around on a keyboard or piano until something comes along that makes your ears perk up like a dog's.

examples.text: »Keine Chance, Alter, die nudelt mit so 'nem Typen aus Pankow rum«, sagte Nils fast mitleidig.
examples.translation: “No way, dude, she's screwing around with some guy from Pankow,” Nils said almost compassionately.
examples.english: “No way, dude, she's screwing around with some guy from Pankow,” Nils said almost compassionately.
